title: 孙悟空·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 金棕皮毛间可见小巧金色头箍，弯曲长尾保留猿猴形态。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Wukong is an adult monkey-like vastaya with golden-brown fur, a lively simian face, expressive ears, a small golden headband, and a long curling tail. Preserve his agile species-specific adult proportions rather than an ordinary human or infant mascot. Fully covering red-gold armor, tunic, opaque trousers, arm guards, and boots conceal the body, while his long gold-tipped staff stays grounded and inactive.
art_direction.scene: A closer three-quarter study with all essential anatomy and props included, expressive head and strongly varied line weight. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: golden brown, vermilion, gold, cool blue shadow; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
